title: Default catalog entry auto-installs on first run; CI check guards against accidental swallowing of security-impacting edits
context: Default=true entry downloads and executes unsandboxed code on every new machine. Configuration looks innocent but has code consequences.
decision: Guard catalog edits in CI with maintainer requirement. Document that CODEOWNERS is the actual boundary (server-side evaluation). First-run installs fail quietly on network outage.
consequences: Contributor adds entry; merge blocked until maintainer takes over. CI prevents pull requests from relaxing their own gate. New users get friendly degradation without red warnings.
